results.problem: Dynamic k-edge-connectivity maintenance (edge insertion / redundancy elimination)
results.quote: After an edge insertion, the algorithm identifies and removes a distinct redundant edge to maintain sparsity, in O(k log n) amortized time.

results.problem: Dynamic k-edge-connectivity maintenance (edge deletion / connectivity restoration)
results.quote: After an edge deletion that reduces \lambda(G) below k, the algorithm restores k-edge-connectivity by adding at most two new edges (excluding the deleted edge), in O(k^{3/2} n^{3/2}) time.
Throughout all updates, the graph is maintained with O(kn) edges.
